description: Pre-install security gate for npm packages that screens for malicious lifecycle scripts.
how_used_jev: Runs a ~100ms Jev check before an npm install using three typed primitives: Choice (intent), Score (severity), and Noul (exfiltration / curl-to-bash detection).
author: @GNUmanth

replaces.notes: candidate to compare against paid supply-chain scanners (e.g. Socket) - not yet researched

security_status.notes: exists specifically to catch malicious install scripts - a false negative here is exactly what the Watchdog lens should track
